Why Kavuni

An heirloom rice, once reserved for royalty.

Kavuni arisi is a rare purple-black rice from Tamil Nadu, prized for centuries and nearly forgotten. We source it directly from small farms and stone-grind it in-house — nothing added, nothing stripped away.

How it's made

From farm to your kitchen shelf

1

Sourced

Kavuni rice, hibiscus and pea flowers sourced from small Tamil Nadu farms.

2

Sun-dried

Flowers and grains are slow sun-dried to lock in colour and nutrients.

3

Stone-ground

Milled in small batches on a traditional stone grinder — no heat, no shortcuts.

4

Hand-packed

Weighed, jarred and sealed by hand, then shipped within 48 hours.
